lines.sentence: The sounds of a horn echoes through the nightly mist as the sight of a ghostly precession comes your way. Huntsman atop their horses. A whisper reaches out on the wind, telling you to make way for the precision. Do you stand your ground to watch or move?

choices.choiceText: Stand your ground, ready to face their impending might as it will test yours.
You legs shuffle to the side as you don’t quite feel you are ready to handle the challenge of the hunt.

lines.sentence: The slow calm of your soul eases the rigid spirits, allowing rallying behind the winged warriors.
The souls are now in Valhalla’s embrace, and for that I thank you.
I understand, and wish you luck on your future journeys.
